situation: 2 years at a logistics startup. When my lead left in March I took over warehouse scheduling and cut overtime by about $40k. I'm on $72k, the market for this role looks like $85k. Need to message my manager Kevin on Slack to set up the talk.
reply: Hi Kevin, could we set aside 30 minutes next week to talk about my role and compensation? The scope has grown a lot since I took over warehouse scheduling in March, and I'd like to give it proper time rather than squeeze it into our Thursday 1:1. Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon both work for me.
note: Book first, ask in the room: bring the $40k overtime saving and the $85k figure to the meeting, not to Slack.

situation: Hatte heute mein Gespräch mit meiner Chefin Frau Albers wegen der Beförderung zur Teamleiterin. Sie will das mit dem Geschäftsführer Herrn Brandt besprechen, hat aber kein Datum genannt. Ich will eine Follow-up-Mail schreiben.
reply: Liebe Frau Albers, vielen Dank für das offene Gespräch heute. Zur Bestätigung: Sie besprechen die Beförderung zur Teamleiterin zum 1. Januar mit Herrn Brandt und geben mir bis zum 30. Oktober Bescheid. Bis Freitag schicke ich Ihnen noch die Übersicht zur Einarbeitung der drei neuen Kolleginnen, falls sie für das Gespräch hilft. Viele Grüße, Jana Keller
note: Das Datum für die Antwort steht in der Mail, auch wenn es im Gespräch gefehlt hat.

situation: My manager said no raise this year because of the hiring freeze. I asked for 8% after leading the checkout redesign. I'm a UX designer and I don't want to just drop it.
reply: Understood, and thanks for being straight with me about the freeze. While salary is fixed, could we move me to the senior designer title now, since I've been leading the checkout redesign, and put the 8% first in line for the January review? I'll add a note to both our calendars for 15 January.
note: Trade a lever that costs no budget now, and lock in a date for the money.

situation: My company just published salary bands. I'm a senior analyst on $68,000 and the band for my level is $74,000 to $88,000. I lead the pricing model now. Want to raise it with my manager Laura without sounding accusatory.
reply: Hi Laura, now that the pay bands are published, I noticed my salary of $68,000 sits below the $74,000 to $88,000 band for senior analyst. I'd like to understand how my pay was set, and whether we can bring it to $78,000, given I now own the pricing model. Could we find 30 minutes next week to talk it through? Thursday or Friday afternoon both work.
note: Anchor on the published band and your scope, never on a colleague's pay, and name the number you want.

situation: 我在一家跨境电商公司做数据分析三年，月薪1.8万。上周拿到另一家公司2.4万的offer，要在10月12号前回复。我其实更想留下，想跟领导王姐谈加薪，怎么提这个offer才不像威胁？
reply: 王姐，我很喜欢现在的工作，也想在这个团队长期做下去。过去一年我搭了广告投放的归因看板，投放组的获客成本降了大约15%，新人的数据培训现在也是我在带。坦白说，上周我拿到了另一家公司月薪2.4万的offer，但我更想留下，所以想先跟您谈：能不能把我的月薪调到2.3万？需要什么材料去跟张总申请，我这周都可以准备。那边要我10月12日前答复，所以想请您10月9日周五前给我一个结果。
note: 外部offer只提一次，语气平静，先说想留下；只有真的会去才提，否则就别拿它当筹码。
